description: Return the price-concession events for a medicine, by exact dm+d code or a substring of its name, newest first. A concession is a financial-exposure and market-stress signal, published as the source states it. Provide `code` or `name`.

code.description: An exact dm+d code (VMP identifier), e.g. "42381011000001106".

name.description: A case-insensitive substring of the medicine name, e.g. "ramipril".

name: concessions_for
title: Price concessions for a medicine
